_readme: TGE treasury ledger rendered by components/GDVMTokenomics.js. Edit by hand; the view recomputes everything from this file.
tge.date        genesis day (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD). Anchors the pixa.rex distribution roadmap. 2026-09-04 12:00:03 UTC per the v1.29.0 release notes.
accounts[]      one object per treasury: name, role (team | company | dpf), control (multisig | protocol), genesis {amount, asset},
holds (asset the account carries today), transfers (assets it may send; [] = protocol only), can_vote,
policy {kind: discretionary} | {kind: timed_distribution, min_years, max_years} | {kind: proposals, daily_budget_divider}.
ledger[]        one object per outflow, newest or oldest first (the view sorts): date, from, to, amount, asset, category,
optional note, status (done | planned — planned rows are listed but not counted), earmarks [{to, amount, asset, status, note}]
for what the recipient does with the funds downstream, unvest: true to show the recipient's live power-down.
categories      contributor_reward | sale | market_distribution | grant | other (unknown values are shown as typed).
VERIFY          the ledger dates below are read off the wallet's '2 weeks ago' (2026-09-24) — replace them with the block timestamps.

ledger.note: Powered down by the operating account and sold on exchanges.
